data.narrative:
Proxima Fusion is a Series A nuclear energy company that has raised €200M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a nuclear energy peer set comprising 3 public equities (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private companies including Fuse Energy, Helion, Valar Atomics, and X-Energy.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-Progression methodology applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the €200M raised proxy, yielding $400M. The Peer-Median approach examines three same-sector comparables across adjacent stages: Valar Atomics at Series B valued at $6.0B, Nano Nuclear Energy at Seed valued at $808M, and Fuse Energy at Series A valued at $200M. The median of this set is $808M, with a range spanning $200M to $6.0B. These methods are equally weighted in triangulation, producing a low of $340M, median of $604M, and high of $929M.

The analysis supports a valuation range of approximately $340M–$929M, with a median estimate of $604M. Key uncertainties center on stage-appropriate comparability within the nuclear energy sector, given the wide dispersion in peer valuations ($200M–$6.0B), and the limited data on Proxima's specific technical and commercial progress relative to the peer set.
